notes.title: The Terms of Service for MIMESIS have been revised
notes.content:
[list][*][p]The Terms of Service for MIMESIS have been revised.[/p][/*][*][p]The newly added content is as follows:[/p][/*][*][p]For more details, please refer to the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/eula/2827200_eula_0"]LINK[/url] [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]20. AI Features and Data Use
a) The Game includes artificial intelligence (“AI”) features that simulate in-game characters, including the main monster “Mimesis.” When you play the Game, you will interact with these AI-powered characters.
These AI features are driven by pre-trained models that generate fixed, predefined responses based on Environmental Data collected during your gameplay. Environmental Data refers to contextual information such as your character’s in-game location, triggered events, sensor readings, and the status of nearby objects. The AI does not update itself, evolve, or learn in real time based on your interactions. However, Environmental Data may be used later in an offline setting to further train or improve the AI models.b) Non-Human Nature and Output Characteristics - The AI system is not a human being and may simulate human-like responses. All character behavior are the result of scripted responses based on static models and predefined logic. These outputs do not reflect the thoughts, views, or intentions of any real person.c) Disclaimer of Liability and User Awareness - All outputs generated by the AI system are coincidental. Any resemblance to real people (living or dead), events, or situations is purely coincidental and unintentional. The Company disclaims all liability for any interpretation, reaction, or reliance based on the AI’s responses. Users must not interpret AI behavior as reflective of real-world facts or opinions, nor attribute intent, judgment, or agency to the AI or its creators. As interactions with AI-driven elements in the Game are based on user discretion, they should be approached with care and without misuse. The Company is not liable for any harm or confusion that may result from misinterpretation or unintended reliance on AI-generated content.[/p]

notes.title: [HOTFIX – June 11th ]
notes.content: [p]Greetings, Survivors.[/p][p] [/p][p]We’d like to share details regarding recent improvements and fixes made to enhance your gaming experience.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]1. Improved a rare issue that occurred during tram repairs.[/b][/h3][h3][b]2. Improved a character movement and monster animations under unstable 3. network conditions.[/b][/h3][h3][b]4. Improved an issue where some users were unable to join the game properly.[/b][/h3][h3][b]5. Fixed an issue where the microphone appeared as “NONE” and could not be selected in the settings menu.[/b][/h3][h3][b]6. Improved a rare issue where item purchases in the shop were not processed correctly.[/b][/h3][h3][b]7. Improved various functions related to network synchronization.[/b][/h3][p] [/p][p]Improved multiple issues that were causing inconvenience while using MIMESIS.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Users with different versions of the game will not be able to play together.[/b][/h3][h3][b]please make sure to get the update and restart the game.[/b][/h3][h3][/h3][p]If the update does not proceed automatically or the button remains inactive, please exit the Steam client completely and reconnect to initiate the update.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]
